scripts.build: bun run build:page && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:page: bun build src/page/main.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming page.[ext] --target browser --format iife --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && cp src/page/index.html dist/ && bun build src/soundfield/main.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming soundfield.[ext] --target browser --format iife --minify && cp src/soundfield/index.html dist/soundfield.html
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/main.ts --outfile dist/render.mjs --target node --packages external && bun build src/cli/soundfield.ts --outfile dist/soundfield.mjs --target node --packages external
